amends: PREREG.json timing_and_locks.per_block and schedule execution order
reason: Exclusive quiet-lane acquisition was starved by other lanes' shared and exclusive holders on the shared machine: 3 blocks completed in ~50 min (block 3 waited ~35 min for flock -x), which projects to ~15 h for 54 exclusive acquisitions. The lane's rules allow count-only blocks under flock -s with receipts in raw/lock-ledger.jsonl.
state_at_amendment: blocks seq 1-3 (b01-text_v1-1, b02-text_v2-1, b03-focus_v1-1) completed under quiet-timed; block seq 4 was waiting for the exclusive lock, never acquired it (no ledger receipt, no session started) and was stopped by this lane (its own processes only) together with the batch runner; nothing else ran

change.timing_blocks: schedule seq 1-18 (round 0: exactly one block of every block type) run under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE + ledger receipt), unchanged. Every REPORTED timing (event-arrival latencies, fixture op / Driver call / mutation durations, retained-listener subscription and cleanup, fresh-listener subscription and cleanup) is computed ONLY from these blocks (analyze.TIMING_MAX_SEQ = 18).
change.count_only_blocks: schedule seq 19-54 run under flock -s on the same quiet-lane lock with one receipt per block in raw/lock-ledger.jsonl (label own20-<block_id>, mode shared). They contribute counts (relevant deltas, L1/L2 presence, false negatives/positives, failures) to the classification only; no timing from them is reported.
change.order: count-only blocks seq 19-54 run first (in schedule order), then the remaining timing blocks seq 4-18 (in schedule order). Every block still runs in its own isolated session under hostless.
change.unchanged: rows, reps, block contents, loop, guard, quiesce window, L1/L2 definitions, delta rules, inherited rows, classification rule and thresholds

risk_disclosed: count-only blocks may run while other lanes' shared work (builds, tests) loads the machine; an event delayed beyond the 1000 ms window would count as a false negative. loadavg is recorded per mutation, so any false negative can be checked against load.
